import numpy as np
from manifold3d import Manifold, Mesh
v=np.ascontiguousarray(np.array([[9,-1,-1],[11,-1,-1],[11,1,-1],[9,1,-1],[9,-1,1],[11,-1,1],[11,1,1],[9,1,1]],dtype=np.float32)); f=np.ascontiguousarray(np.array([[0,1,2],[0,2,3],[4,6,5],[4,7,6],[0,4,5],[0,5,1],[1,5,6],[1,6,2],[2,6,7],[2,7,3],[3,7,4],[3,4,0]],dtype=np.uint32))

    bb=r.bounding_box()
    print(ang, bb)
